subject: Regional custody checklist & switchover authority for EU/APAC private deployments
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Lars Nielsen <lars.nielsen@scandia-banks.com>, scandia-cloudops@scandia-banks.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Regional custody checklist & switchover authority for EU/APAC private deployments

Hi Lars / Scandia ops team —

We're progressing toward the private deployment handoff for your EU primary and APAC standby topology. Before we schedule the final cutover window, we need the following items from Scandia and to confirm Redwood owners: 

1) Proof of EU data custody: signed statement or certificate that identifies the EU data custodian and the physical location(s) for persisted model/data storage.
2) Switchover authorization: an authorized signatory to approve an APAC failover (we've attached a short authorization template).
3) KMS / key custody note: confirm if Scandia will provide a cloud KMS key (BYOK) or you want Redwood-managed keys scoped to your VPC. Include any rotation / HSM constraints.
4) Network egress/ingress confirmation: complete list of IP ranges, ASN, and required outbound ports for health checks so we can pre-authorize peering and firewall rules.
5) RTO/RPO expectations for EU->APAC switchover and any compliance guardrails (must-stay-in-EU data sets).

We'd like to collect these by EOD Wed (2026-11-11) so we can finalize the runbook and pull the DocuSign for the switchover authorization. Attachments: residency-evidence-request.docx, switchover-authorization-template.pdf.

Owners at Redwood: Vanessa (project lead), Rishi (infra/crypto), Marissa (customer ops).

Thanks — please call out any blockers.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Lars Nielsen <lars.nielsen@scandia-banks.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Regional custody checklist & switchover authority for EU/APAC private deployments

Vanessa —

Quick tech clarifications so we can scope the runbook: 

- KMS: If Scandia provides a BYOK HSM key, we'll need the key ARN and a short window to validate access from the EU VPC. Cross-region key wrapping is supported but requires explicit policy entries. If Redwood manages keys, we'll provide a CMK scoped to the EU tenancy; note that some customers prefer HSM-only logging for audit.
- KV cache & replica state: for warm-standby (EU primary / APAC standby) we keep persisted artifacts in the EU region by default. For failover to APAC we perform a controlled cross-region sync for transient artifacts; this requires signed authorization per dataset.
- Networking: pre-authorize the following outbound ranges for health checks and control-plane callbacks: 34.200.0.0/16, 52.23.0.0/16 (placeholder — we'll provide final list once we have ASN). We also need BGP ASNs for peering.
- Split-brain prevention: we'll include an election leader check and a manual failover gate (requires signatory).

I'll draft the infra section of the runbook once we have the custodian and KMS decision.

— Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Vanessa —

We can provide the following immediately: 

- Signed custody statement (attached: scandia-signed-custody-statement.pdf). This declares EU data custodianship and physical rack locations in Copenhagen and Frankfurt.
- SOC2 Type II report (link below) and a short export control note for data classes that must remain in EU.
- We will provide a temporary BYOK test key for validation; permanent HSM procurement is underway but delayed by vendor lead time (ETA Q1 2027).
- IP ranges: 198.51.100.0/22 (egress), 203.0.113.0/24 (ingress health checks). We can open a ticket to exchange exact prefixes and ASNs.

Requested clarifications from our side: 
- Can Redwood guarantee that persisted user artifacts marked 'EU-only' will never be replicated to APAC? We need explicit statements in the runbook.
- During a switchover test, will logs and audit trails be preserved and available in the EU retention silo?

We uploaded the SOC2 bundle and key attestation to the shared drive: https://drive.scandia/secure/SOC2-evidence-2026.

Regards,
Lars Nielsen
Head of Cloud Ops — Scandia Bank
